title: widget.update
description: Widget data update broadcast over SSE (provider refresh, custom push, hydration and degraded updates). The data field of GET /api/widgets/{widget_id} carries the same payload for the same widget.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 time the data was produced

state.description: Widget health state, e.g. healthy or degraded

data.description: Domain data; shape is defined by the widget type's manifest response_schema
